description: Charis Greek transliteration. Reconstructed 2026-07-24 from committed examples (tyrew = τηρέω, aparxy = ἀπαρχή) plus one-letter-per-letter principle; ratified by user 2026-07-24 (upsilon = 'u', resolving the collision with attested eta = 'y'; DICT hy- spellings like hypsos are conventional lemma names, not Charis transliterals). confidence marks provenance: 'attested' = from committed examples; 'inferred' = chosen at ratification.
note: Lowercase shown; capitalize per source. Diacritics/breathings dropped except rough breathing → leading 'h' (inferred — hypsos, hypostasis in DICT suggest it). Iota subscript dropped (inferred).
